title: Rogers' craft as human-built but aerodynamically pointless

tellings.quote: >> I I think that what I saw was uh human um built.

plain: In 2000, a NASA doctor named Greg Rogers says he saw a strange craft inside a secret hangar, and he believes it was built by humans even though its shape made no sense for flying. Rogers tells Michels this firsthand: "I think that what I saw was... human built." If true, it would mean some craft taken for alien are secret human machines.
